about: Reference defects adjudicated by the director. The Python outcome stays recorded in expected.json; the Go port is held to the corrected expectation here instead. Every other Go/Python difference is a finding.

cases.scenario: handoff: a replaced stream file is a new incarnation
cases.why: Python raises NameError (OwnedFault not imported in _recover); an unbounded launch must fail owned.

cases.scenario: handoff: worker end -> verifier -> terminal rest
cases.why: Verdict and disposition now commit in one transaction, so there is no separate verify result to report.

cases.scenario: handoff: an invalid disposition fails the close; a retry still marks it closed
cases.why: The disposition is validated before anything commits; Python commits the verdict, then the decide fails.

cases.scenario: handoff: an invalid disposition fails the close; a retry still marks it closed
cases.why: A retry must never report terminal-rest while the ledger holds no disposition.

cases.scenario: handoff: declared intent rolls forward, director close recovers
cases.why: An intent alone (no declared disposition, none in the ledger) is incomplete closure, not terminal-rest.

final_excluded.scenario: handoff: worker end -> verifier -> terminal rest
final_excluded.why: finding 2: different close records; asserted by internal/host/closure_test.go

final_excluded.scenario: handoff: an invalid disposition fails the close; a retry still marks it closed
final_excluded.why: finding 2: no verdict, seen or done is written; asserted by closure_test.go

final_excluded.scenario: handoff: declared intent rolls forward, director close recovers
final_excluded.why: finding 2: done stays unset; asserted by closure_test.go

final_corrected.scenario: host timers: create, reuse, conflict, refuse, query, cancel
final_corrected.ruling: P12 package.md section E (Tern 1315196): step-timer precision and reload robustness
final_corrected.why: P12 measured on real systemd (evidence/e-reload-timers-run1.txt) that daemon-reload restarts an --on-active countdown and that the default AccuracySec is 1 min. A deadline with a known UTC instant is armed as an explicit-UTC --on-calendar timer with AccuracySec=1s. Python arms --on-active and stays recorded in expected.json.
